notes.title: 2025-07-11 Daily updates
notes.notes:
1.Added the function of the old version to limit the mouse range. After consideration, the feature is still very practical, so add.
2.Add the ability to call up the settings window at any time, and it will not be adjustable if the user settings are incorrect. It can now be brought up in the small icon in the bottom right corner.

notes.title: Update before summer
notes.notes:
[p]1.Added the function of learning to draw, and provided 4 pictures from shallow to deep. 
2.Support for a new language, Russian.[/p][p][/p][p][b]With "Blank Wallpaper", it is more convenient for daily use[/b][/p]
